description: Render images of specific nodes in a Figma design file. Returns a map of node id to a rendered image URL. Use to get visual previews (PNG, SVG, or JPG) of frames, components, or layers from a design.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (the segment after /file/ or /design/ in a Figma URL).

node_ids.description: Comma-separated list of node ids to render (e.g. "1:2,1:3").

name: get_file_images
title: Get File Images
